title: 面向可评估AI的论证基础
summary: 本文主张使用计算论证作为可评估AI（EAI）的形式化基础，通过呈现竞争性假设及其证据来支持人类决策，而非单一推荐。旨在实现可解释、可质疑的分布式人本EAI系统，提出长期研究议程。
summary_en: This position paper advocates computational argumentation as a formal foundation for Evaluative AI (EAI), which supports human decision-making by presenting competing hypotheses with evidence, aiming for explainable, contestable, distributed, and human-centred EAI systems.
